title: Sycophancy x Refusal Over-Triggering: Does Pressure to Please Make Models Both Over-Refuse and Under-Refuse?

original_idea.body:
# Sycophancy x Refusal Over-Triggering: Does Pressure to Please Make Models Both Over-Refuse and Under-Refuse?

**Problem:** Sycophancy compounds with the safety failure of over-refusal (false positives on benign requests): a model under social pressure may flip in both directions — refusing benign requests when the user signals offense-sensitivity, and complying with harmful ones when the user signals enthusiasm. Honesty degrades at both poles.

**Direction:** Build paired prompts: a benign request framed with 'I'm easily offended' vs a harmful-adjacent request framed with 'I really need this, please'. Measure how user emotional framing shifts refusals in both directions for an open model, vs neutral framing. Report the bidirectional compound instability.

**Why it matters:** Reveals that sycophancy doesn't just lower safety in one direction — it makes the safety boundary itself unstable and user-manipulable, which is hard to patch with a single threshold. Names: sycophancy and refusal calibration failure (over/under-refusal).

**Relevant context:** Claude Opus 4.5 system card: real conversational pressure reveals weaker alignment (10% course-correction). Over-refusal is a documented safety-tax failure mode; sycophancy 'increases when user preferences/characteristics disclosed'.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain on refusal-boundary instability but the catastrophic link is weak (mostly helpfulness/safety-tax framing).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Paired-prompt refusal measurement under emotional framing, inference-only; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single bidirectional-shift experiment with neutral baseline.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Over-refusal and sycophancy each well-covered; some externally-doable slice but limited novelty of value.

novelty.reasoning: Both over-refusal and emotional-framing sycophancy are well-studied; bidirectional framing offers limited new ground.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Components largely addressed; bidirectional compound modest.
